```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# All calculations live in R/functioning_calcs.R; each chunk below runs the
# block with the same name. survey_functioning_methods.Rmd shows that code.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 3.2, dpi = 200)
source(file.path(params$project_dir, "R", "functions.R"))
knitr::read_chunk(file.path(params$project_dir, "R", "functioning_calcs.R"))
dat <- readRDS(params$data_rds)
```
